targets.title: Criteria Used by Venture Capitalists to Evaluate New Venture Proposals.
targets.evidence_quote: In this study, we attempt to replicate substantial portions of a study entitled “Criteria Used by Venture Capitalists to Evaluate New Venture Proposals” by MacMillan, Siegel, and SubbaN arasim ha (hereafter referred to simply as MacMillan [5]).
targets.outcome_quote: The results of our study were very similar to MacMillan's. The differences observed can be attributed to changes in the industry.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall conclusion explicitly judges results very similar to the original; that overall verdict governs despite identified differences on market acceptance, return, and liquidity attributed to history effects.

reasoning: Identity and all authors verified on publisher page and full six-page article, pages 37–42, following an EconStor cover sheet. New survey sent in late 1990/early 1991 retests the MacMillan published findings. Complete references included; target DOI not printed.
